description: Binds a variable from this file to a property, so the value follows the token rather than being a copy of it. Use "fill" or "stroke" for a colour variable; for a number use the property name, like cornerRadius, itemSpacing, paddingLeft, width or opacity.

field.description: "fill", "stroke", or a numeric property such as cornerRadius or itemSpacing.

nodeId.description: Figma node id, like "21:10314". Omit to use whatever is selected on the canvas.

name: figma_bind_variable
title: Bind a variable
